task: I placed an order for lunch meeting with some of my coworkers in office today. I had sent out an email yesterday to them asking for individual orders, and everyone involved responded with their chosen food item and its base price. The tip was was 20% on the food cost, and delivery fee was $11. Unlike individual orders, the tip and delivery fee are to be equally shared among all, including me. Make all the necessary (public) venmo requests with a description note, "For Lunch Meeting".
